integrity: The packaged proof establishes the infinite family; the standalone exhaustive checker covers 1 through 6 leaves. Self-review only, with no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: All statements concern labeled loopless finite stars and six explicitly defined partial-transformation monoids.
Only two asymptotic ratio limits, not individual sharp growth equivalents, are established.
The primary structural classifications are prior work; an unindexed equivalent idempotent enumeration remains a priority risk.
title: Idempotent rank profiles and a weak–strong split for partial star endomorphisms
